title: user.deleted (v1)
description: A user account was erased. Emitted when an account is erased (identifiers, credentials and profile removed, a tombstone kept): immediate deletion by an administrator, scheduled self-service deletion after the grace period, clean-up of expired unverified registrations or unused guest accounts (lifecycle job), the source account of a completed account merge (user.merged follows). Sessions and grants are revoked (session.revoked with reason "account_deleted"); the user's memberships are marked removed without organization.membership.removed events. Requesting or cancelling a self-service deletion does not emit an event. org_id is never set.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

user_id.description: The erased user. The identifier is never reused.

org_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.
